headlines.title: House passes bill to shield consumers from data center price hikes on energy
headlines.description: Under pressure to act on unpopular data centers, the House passed bipartisan legislation to shield consumers from higher energy costs.

headlines.title: House passes Russia sanctions bill named for Lindsey Graham, sending it to Trump
headlines.description: The legislation, which passed the Senate last month, would target Russia’s energy sector by punishing the largest buyers of its oil and gas to slash revenues Russia uses to attack Ukraine.

headlines.title: Remembering reporter Eliana Moreno and pilot George Marciniw
headlines.description: Eliana Moreno and George Marciniw were dedicated journalists who covered some of the most important stories in Los Angeles. Their friends and colleagues from NBC Los Angeles paid tribute to their memories.

headlines.title: Ed Sheeran’s Opening Acts Drop out in Solidarity With Macklemore
headlines.description: Fallout is growing over rapper Macklemore’s removal from Ed Sheeran’s tour with now every one of Sheeran’s music openers and his onstage band announcing that they would no longer take part in the tour. Sheeran is also speaking out, saying “Macklemore coming off tour was the promoter’s decision, it was not mine.” NBC’s Liz Kreutz reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Merriam-Webster gives its dictionary a ‘glow-up’ with 1,400 new words and definitions
headlines.description: Words and phrases that made it into the dictionary include “shapewear,” “looksmaxxing” and “superfood.”

headlines.title: Gaza documentary praised at Venice sparks fury in Israel
headlines.description: The documentary "NAZA" alleges the IDF used AI software to knowingly kill civilians in Gaza. It won a 25-minute standing ovation at Venice — but Israeli leaders are calling it treason. NBC News' Matt Bradley reports.

headlines.title: Travis Kelce named as victim in alleged multi-million dollar Ponzi scheme
headlines.description: Travis Kelce was named in court as one of the victims of Siddharth Jawahar, who defrauded investors of more than $35 million. NBC News' Gary Grumbach reports on Kelce's connection to Jawahar's investment firm, Swiftarc Ventures.

headlines.title: Supreme Court pushes back against Trump and GOP ahead of the midterm elections
headlines.description: The Supreme Court’s recent rulings on mail-in ballots and redistricting foreshadow a frosty reception to further attempts to change the rules before the election, experts said.

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: Travis Kelce was among the victims of a man’s multimillion-dollar Ponzi scheme
headlines.description: Siddharth Jawahar was sentenced to 11 years in prison and ordered to repay $31 million in restitution to investors who he defrauded from 2016 to 2023.
